# Tomás Campoy Rojo

Tomás Campoy Rojo is a Data Engineer at Universidad Católica San Antonio de Murcia (UCAM), Spain.

Primary topics: data engineering, data platforms, AWS, Azure, Databricks, Apache Spark, Apache Airflow, dbt, Polars, SQL, lakehouse architecture, streaming data, data quality, institutional analytics.
